semanticSummary: Excel-driven tag import macro for AVEVA Elements. Reads source tag data from an Excel workbook via NETGRIDCONTROL/NETDATASOURCE, identifies column indices for NAME, ACTTYPE, and :RAMACTION columns. Iterates rows, cleans tag names (replace dashes, en-dashes, spaces with underscores), strips special characters from type names via iterative replace loop, creates element tags via CREATEELEMENT/ELEMENTTYPE API with type validation (UNKNOWN check), sets attributes with type-gated conversion (REAL→.real(), DBREF→.dbref() with / prefix, STRING→.string()), writes issue/feedback Excel report, calls SAVEWORK and UNCLAIM ALL for cleanup. Uses Aveva.Engineering.PMLElementManager namespace.
patternsUsed: Special character stripping via iterative replace
Nested handle blocks (handle any within handle none)
STRING methods (replace, trim, lowcase, upcase, split, empty)
